description: Run by the Renovate job on echoes (Joyaroin/renovate). Every update, majors included, merges itself once CI passes: a merge only deploys staging, so promote is where a person checks staging before prod. CI covers typecheck, lint, build and a few test sets, not the database tests or a browser: a major can pass it and still change behaviour.

packageRules.description: Minor and patch npm updates of stable packages: one pull request a week. Majors, and 0.x packages where any bump can break, stay one pull request each.
Node.js moves as one: the Dockerfile's images, CI's node-version and @types/node, so the types never describe a different runtime.
docker-compose's Postgres is for local development and matches Neon's major version, 17. When Neon's changes, change this limit with it.

Out of the grouped pull request, so one of them failing CI doesn't hold the rest back: better-auth renamed getIp to getIP and moved @better-auth/core/context in a 1.6.x minor (#507), and a squawk-cli minor added a lint rule that fails on already-applied migrations. Each still merges itself once its own CI is green.
